archetype: RETRO FANTASY POINT-AND-CLICK ADVENTURE (SWISS BRUTALIST PIXEL FRAME)
emotional_tone: Mysterious, strange, vintage pixel fantasy, atmospheric suspense, classic PC adventure gaming nostalgia

typography.h1_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-widest text-[#E5A93C] uppercase

borders_and_frames.retro_border_outer: border-4 border-black ring-4 ring-[#C89D39] rounded-none shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
borders_and_frames.retro_panel: bg-[#141C1A] border-4 border-black p-4 text-[#F4E8C1] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]
borders_and_frames.hotspot_hover: ring-2 ring-[#FFB834] bg-[#FFB834]/20 backdrop-blur-[1px] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,184,52,0.6)] cursor-pointer transition-all duration-150

spacing_and_layout.viewport_aspect_ratio: aspect-video w-full relative overflow-hidden bg-black border-4 border-black ring-2 ring-[#C89D39]
spacing_and_layout.bottom_panel_layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 p-4 bg-[#141C1A] border-4 border-black

key_components.TitleScreen: Full-screen pixel backdrop (village or misty_woods) with heavy black border frame, pulsing 'NEW GAME' & 'CONTINUE' buttons in retro pixel gold typography, audio ambient toggle, and save slot preview modal.
key_components.SceneViewer: 16:9 fixed ratio stage rendering background pixel-art scene with dynamic clickable hotspot overlay boxes. Displays crisp hover outlines, cursor indicator icon, and top objective hint bar overlay.
key_components.HotspotOverlay: Absolute positioning percentage-based interactive areas with pixelated cursor icons, hover tooltip labels in retro gold tags, and click sound/effect triggers.
key_components.NarrationLog: Classic bottom adventure box with typewriter text scroll effect, log history toggle, and speaker tag styling.
key_components.InventoryBar: Fixed horizontal slot grid displaying collected items (e.g. Ancient Key, Glowing Rune, Silver Dagger, Rusty Lantern). Items can be selected, examined, or combined with hotspots.
key_components.DialogueOverlay: NPC interaction overlay with portrait asset (shopkeeper, mage_twins, princess), text narrative box, and 2-4 numbered retro response option buttons.
key_components.SpecialPromptInput: Typed action terminal box used only in key puzzle/combat moments (e.g., typing magic words, deciphering runes, or countering enemy moves). Features forgiving fuzzy-matching parser and hint guidance.
key_components.CombatEncounterPanel: Turn-based retro encounter overlay showing enemy sprite, telegraph threat text, action menu (Attack, Defend, Use Item, Cast Spell), and typed finisher box.
key_components.DeathScreen: Retro game over screen with comical fantasy death text, crimson pixel border flash, 'RELOAD CHECKPOINT' & 'RESTART ADVENTURE' options.
key_components.GameMenu: Top-bar floating control panel containing Save Game (localStorage), Load Game, Restart, Quest Log, Sound Effects/BGM toggle, and Help/Controls modal.

data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, hotspot clicks, inventory slots, dialogue choices, typed inputs, menu buttons) must include specific data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case e.g. data-testid='start-game-button', data-testid='hotspot-gate-keeper', data-testid='inventory-item-key', data-testid='dialogue-choice-1', data-testid='typed-action-input'.
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components follow the retro fantasy pixel-art aesthetic with solid black frames (#000000) and gold accent borders (#C89D39).
Use Google Fonts 'Press Start 2P' and 'VT323' via HTML head font import or index.css @import for genuine CRT retro game typography.

Use local pixel art assets located in public/assets/ (village.jpg, forest_edge.jpg, misty_woods.jpg, castle_gate.jpg, castle_stairs.jpg, throne_hall.jpg, cliff_fall.jpg, shopkeeper.jpg, mage_twins.jpg, princess.jpg).
Ensure input parser handles typos gracefully (lowercase normalization, keyword inclusion matching) so typed choices feel fun and non-frustrating.
Implement full local storage persistence for save points, inventory items, quest states, and sound settings.
Never rely on default browser transparent backgrounds; keep dialogue overlay and panels opaque with #141C1A dark retro panel backgrounds.
Include sound effects (using Web Audio API synthesizers or simple beep effects) for retro clicks, hotspot discoveries, and item pickup feedback.
Ensure all interactive elements carry relevant data-testid attributes for automated verification.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT center align main layout container globally; preserve structured retro CRT frame boundaries.
Do NOT use generic modern sans-serif fonts for headings; stick strictly to pixel/monospace fonts.
Do NOT use pure #000000 gradients; use flat deep dark backgrounds (#0B0F0E and #141C1A) with crisp 4px solid borders.
Ensure responsive layout scales cleanly on smaller screens while preserving the 16:9 aspect ratio box for scene viewer.
Add keyboard navigation shortcuts (1-4 for dialogue choices, Enter for text input, Esc for menu).
